patch.value: Identity refusal table omits linked-test updated_by and plan step owner, so those identity locations still accept URL userinfo

Found by the Codex review of PR 1714 (final round). After pm-ziv9yb, the URL-userinfo identity refusal judges the top-level author, assignee and claim_principal and a declared table of nested identity paths (comments, notes, learnings, dependencies, plan_decisions and plan_discoveries author, and the linked-test provenance author). Two identity locations in src/types.ts are not in the table: a linked test's updated_by (the author of its most recent metadata edit) and a plan step's owner. Both were unchecked before PR 1714 as well, so this is a gap in coverage rather than a regression. A runtime or registered field mapped onto tests or plan_steps can therefore store one of those identities with URL userinfo. Fix: add both entry paths to the declared table and pin them in the url-credentials spec.
A tests entry updated_by or a plan_steps entry owner carrying URL userinfo is refused naming its entry path; The url-credentials spec pins both paths next to the existing declared paths
Every identity location in the item types is judged
tests updated_by and plan_steps owner are not judged
